PM4_DECODER REBASE FUNCTIONALITY - TEST SUMMARY
================================================================================

MODIFICATIONS MADE
------------------
1. Added command-line argument parsing using getopt_long
   - New option: -r, --rebase <hex_address>
   - New option: -h, --help

2. Added global rebase state tracking:
   - Track new base address
   - Track original base address (from first COPY_DATA)
   - Flag to indicate when base has been found

3. Implemented COPY_DATA packet rebasing:
   - Extract destination address from dwords[4:5] (bytes 16-23)
   - Calculate offset from original base
   - Apply new base + offset
   - Update packet in place

4. Implemented ACQUIRE_MEM packet rebasing:
   - Extract base address from dwords[4:5] (bytes 16-23)
   - Account for 8-bit right shift (address >> 8)
   - Calculate offset from original base
   - Apply new base + offset
   - Re-encode with shift and update packet

5. Added hex output mode:
   - When --rebase is used, output modified hex stream
   - Diagnostic messages go to stderr
   - Modified hex goes to stdout

USAGE
-----
Decode mode (default):
  echo "<hex>" | ./pm4_decoder

Rebase mode:
  echo "<hex>" | ./pm4_decoder --rebase 0xNEWBASEADDR

Help:
  ./pm4_decoder --help

ADDRESS CALCULATION DETAILS
---------------------------

For each packet:
  1. Extract current address from packet
  2. Calculate offset = current_addr - original_base
  3. Calculate new_addr = new_base + offset
  4. Update packet with new_addr

Example for COPY_DATA packet #3:
  current_addr    = 0x00007266124ec008
  original_base   = 0x00007266124ec000
  offset          = 0x00007266124ec008 - 0x00007266124ec000 = 0x8
  new_base        = 0x00000deadbeef000
  new_addr        = 0x00000deadbeef000 + 0x8 = 0x00000deadbeef008

For ACQUIRE_MEM (with bit-shifting):
  stored_addr     = 0x0000007266124ec0  (this is >> 8)
  actual_addr     = 0x00007266124ec000  (shift left 8)
  original_base   = 0x00007266124ec000
  offset          = 0x0
  new_addr        = 0x00000deadbeef000 + 0x0 = 0x00000deadbeef000
  stored_new_addr = 0x0000000deadbeef0  (shift right 8)
